Services
Requests for Quotation
The Purchasing Department maintains a list of requests for proposal and quotation.
You can find more information about the bidding process, along with the application and related home rule resolutions on the Purchasing home page .
Planning Agendas
The Planning Commission agendas and minutes are posted on the Land Use & Development sub-site .
You can also find lots of other resources and information there.
Paying, Filing Taxes
You can get an approximate idea of what it will cost to register your vehicle using the Kansas Vehicle Property Tax Check ,
or you can use the the Kansas Property Tax Payment service.
The Appraiser maintains a webpage for personal property filing .
Open Records Requests
To view information about restrictions and how to request open records information, visit our KORA (Kansas Open Records Act) FAQ .
